```{r setup}
# library(pitw)
devtools::load_all()
library(tidyverse)
.gg_pedantic(size = 0.5)
fig_dir = here::here("vignettes", "main", "fig")
set.seed(1001)
```

Sticking with normally distributed at the moment we want to see what happens 
to the U_pit and D_pit if the number of estimates vary, in a low bias, med bias, high bias
scenario.

We are doing this to establish whether there is a lower number of estimates 
needed to get a sensible pitw result. For starters we can look at this 
in a small range of calibration scenarios.

```{r}
bias_limit = 1
conf_range = 2
runs = 100
variability = 0.5 # this is a dispersion measure

config = tidyr::crossing(
  calibration = c(1/1.5, 1, 1.5),
  bias_location = c(0, 0.5, 1) * bias_limit,
  samples = c(10,100,1000),
  run = 1:runs
) %>% 
  dplyr::group_by(calibration, bias_location, samples) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    true_value = 0,
    bias_dist = "norm",
    bias_scale = exp(runif(runs, -log(conf_range), log(conf_range))),
    sharpness_dist = "lnorm4",
    sharpness_location = bias_scale * calibration,
    sharpness_scale = variability
  )
```


```{r}
sim = config %>% generate_simulation()
scores = sim %>% prediction_scores()

scores = scores %>% 
  mutate(
    confidence = case_when(
      calibration < 1 ~ "overconfident",
      calibration > 1 ~ "conservative",
      TRUE ~ "calibrated"
    ) %>%
      factor(levels = c("conservative", "calibrated", "overconfident")),
  biased = case_when(
      bias_location == 0.5 ~ "medium",
      bias_location == 1 ~ "high",
      TRUE ~ "unbiased"
    ) %>%
      factor(levels = c( "unbiased", "medium", "high")),
  samples = as.factor(samples)
  )
```


```{r}
fig4a = ggplot(scores, aes(y=D_pit, x = confidence, colour= samples, fill = samples))+
  geom_boxplot(outliers=FALSE, alpha = 0.2)+
  facet_wrap(~ biased)+
  ylab("Directed pit-w")+
  xlab(NULL)

fig4a
```

```{r}
ggplot(scores, aes(y=mean_coverage.0.5, x = confidence, colour= samples, fill = samples))+
  geom_boxplot(outliers=FALSE, alpha = 0.2)+
  facet_wrap(~ biased)+
  ylab("mean 50% coverage")

```
```{r}
ggplot(scores, aes(y=mean_crps, x = confidence, colour= samples, fill = samples))+
  geom_boxplot(outliers=FALSE, alpha = 0.2)+
  facet_wrap(~ biased)+
  ylab("mean CRPS")

```
# Detailed pit-w against sample size

```{r}
bias_limit = 1
conf_range = 2
runs = 250
variability = 0 # this is a dispersion measure

config = tidyr::crossing(
  samples = floor(10^seq(1,3,length.out=10)),
  run = 1:runs,
  calibration = c(1/1.5, 1, 1.5)
) %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(
    bias_location = 0,
    true_value = 0,
    bias_dist = "norm",
    bias_scale = 1, #exp(runif(runs, -log(conf_range), log(conf_range))),
    sharpness_dist = "lnorm4",
    sharpness_location = bias_scale * calibration,
    sharpness_scale = variability,
    `(σₑ/σₛ)` = forcats::as_factor(sprintf("%0.2f",calibration))
  ) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(calibration, `(σₑ/σₛ)`, samples)
```


```{r}
sim = config %>% generate_simulation()
scores = sim %>% prediction_scores()


```


```{r}

plot = scores %>% ungroup() %>% group_by(samples, calibration, `(σₑ/σₛ)`) %>% summarise(
  q.0.025 = quantile(D_pit, 0.025),
  q.0.5 = median(D_pit),
  q.0.975 = quantile(D_pit, 0.975)
)

fig4b = ggplot(plot, aes(y=q.0.5,ymin=q.0.025,ymax=q.0.975, x = samples))+
  geom_line(mapping=aes(colour=`(σₑ/σₛ)`))+
  geom_ribbon(mapping=aes(fill=`(σₑ/σₛ)`),alpha=0.2)+
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0)+
  scale_x_log10(n.breaks=9)+
  ylab("Directed pit-w")

fig4b
```

```{r}
.gg_save_as(
  fig4a+fig4b+patchwork::plot_layout(,ncol = 1)+patchwork::plot_annotation(tag_levels="A"),
  file.path(fig_dir, "fig4-sample-size"),
  size = std_size$two_third,
  formats = c("pdf", "eps")
)
```
